people.name: Tarshish
people.line: Distant maritime city known for its wealth and trade

translations.web: Pass through your land like the Nile, daughter of Tarshish. There is no restraint any more.
translations.bsb: Cultivate your land like the Nile, O Daughter of Tarshish; there is no longer a harbor.
translations.kjv: Pass through thy land as a river, O daughter of Tarshish: there is no more strength.
translations.asv: Pass through thy land as the Nile, O daughter of Tarshish; there is no restraint any more.
